title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: In a twilight-blue tank strewn with sea glass and drifting kelp, this small, ear-finned octopus spends its days arranging pebbles into spirals and half-finished patterns, pausing to trace faintly glowing loops in the water with the tip of one curious arm. When a visitor leans close, it drifts over to the glass, tilts its head as if mulling over a question, and then goes back to rearranging everything, just slightly better than before.
